test_case_name: Accept All Cookies on 404 Page After Navigating from Main Menu

intents.intent: Click 'Persone e Famiglie' in the main menu
Click 'Acconsento' to accept all cookies
And then check that the cookie banner is dismissed and cookies are accepted

test_case_name: Open Cookie Options on 404 Page via Main Menu Navigation

intents.intent: Click 'Persone e Famiglie' in the main menu
Click 'Più opzioni' to view cookie options
And then check that the cookie options page is displayed

test_case_name: Close Cookie Banner on 404 Page After Navigating from Main Menu

intents.intent: Click 'Persone e Famiglie' in the main menu
Click the button to close the cookie banner
And then check that the cookie banner is no longer visible

test_case_name: Navigate to 'Vai alla home' from 404 Page via Main Menu

intents.intent: Click 'Persone e Famiglie' in the main menu
Click 'Vai alla home' to return to the home page
And then check that the home page for 'Persone e Famiglie' is displayed

test_case_name: Perform Desktop Search on 404 Page After Navigating from Main Menu

intents.intent: Click 'Persone e Famiglie' in the main menu
Type $name into the 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' search field
Click the button to search (desktop)
And then check that the search results are displayed

test_case_name: Reset Desktop Search on 404 Page After Navigating from Main Menu

intents.intent: Click 'Persone e Famiglie' in the main menu
Type $name into the 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' search field
Click the button to reset the search (desktop)
And then check that the search field is cleared

test_case_name: Perform Mobile Search on 404 Page After Navigating from Main Menu

intents.intent: Click 'Persone e Famiglie' in the main menu
Type $name into the 'Cerca' search field
Click the button to search (mobile)
And then check that the search results are displayed

test_case_name: Access Guest Login on 404 Page After Navigating from Main Menu

intents.intent: Click 'Persone e Famiglie' in the main menu
Type $email into the 'E-mail' field
Type $password into the 'Password' field
Click 'ENTRA' to submit the guest login form
And then check that the guest user is logged in or receives an appropriate error message

test_case_name: Enable 'Mantieni L'accesso' Option During Guest Login on 404 Page

intents.intent: Click 'Persone e Famiglie' in the main menu
Type $email into the 'E-mail' field
Type $password into the 'Password' field
Click the checkbox 'Mantieni L'accesso'
Click 'ENTRA' to submit the guest login form
And then check that the guest user is logged in with the 'Mantieni L'accesso' option enabled or receives an appropriate error message

test_case_name: Recover Password from Guest Login on 404 Page After Navigating from Main Menu

intents.intent: Click 'Persone e Famiglie' in the main menu
Click 'Recupera Password' to initiate password recovery
And then check that the password recovery process is started

test_case_name: Register as Guest from 404 Page After Navigating from Main Menu

intents.intent: Click 'Persone e Famiglie' in the main menu
Click 'Registrati' to start the guest registration process
And then check that the registration form or process is displayed
